title: Rotate before buying a bigger bag
hook: Which orientation fits more identical blocks?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: For these rigid rectangles, rotation changes how many complete rows and columns fit. Empty area can remain unusable when it is in strips narrower than another block.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.

recall.question: A space is 30 × 40 cm. Rigid blocks are 20 × 10 cm. With the 20 cm side along the 30 cm edge, 4 fit and a 10 cm strip is left. How many fit after a quarter-turn?
options: 4: the strip is too narrow for a block
recall.why: Turned, 3 blocks fit across 30 cm (10 cm each) and 2 rows fit along 40 cm (20 cm each): 3 × 2 = 6. Rotation changed which leftover strips are usable. Real clothes are not rigid blocks.
